itinerary.title: North Konkan Entry
activities: Drive from Pune via Tamhini Ghat.
Arrive at Diveagar Beach.
Visit the Suvarna Ganesha Temple and enjoy the long, flat beach.

itinerary.title: The Sea Fort
activities: Travel to Murud-Janjira Fort (accessible by boat).
Spend the afternoon at Shrivardhan Beach, known for its clean sands and betel nut plantations.

itinerary.title: The Dakshin Kashi
activities: Head to Harihareshwar.
Visit the ancient Shiva temple and walk the spectacular cliff-side Pradakshina path.
Evening at the rocky Harihareshwar Beach.

itinerary.title: Return
activities: Scenic drive back to Pune via Mangaon.

packages.title: The "Adventure & Scuba" Hub (Malvan & Tarkarli)
packages.best_for: Adventure seekers and those willing to drive further south.

itinerary.title: The Long Drive
activities: Depart Pune early for a long drive (approx. 8–9 hours) to Malvan/Tarkarli via Kolhapur and Gaganbawda Ghat.

itinerary.title: Scuba & Snorkeling
activities: Spend the day at Sindhudurg Fort.
Enjoy scuba diving or snorkeling in the clear waters near the fort.
Evening at Chivla Beach.

itinerary.title: Backwaters & Dolphins
activities: Head to Devbagh.
Take a boat ride to see the "Sangam" (confluence of river and sea), Tsunami Island, and spot dolphins in the morning.

itinerary.title: Secret Beaches
activities: Visit Kunkeshwar Temple (the "Kashi of Konkan" on the beach) and the nearby Vayangani Beach for a peaceful, tourist-free experience.

itinerary.title: Return
activities: Early morning start for the drive back to Pune.

itinerary.title: Quick Getaway
activities: A short drive from Mumbai to Alibaug.
Visit Kolaba Fort (accessible during low tide).
Evening at Varsoli or Nagaon Beach.

itinerary.title: Forts & Camping Vibes
activities: Head south to Revdanda Fort and the beach.
Visit the Korlai Fort and Lighthouse for a 360-degree view of the ocean and the Kundalika river.

itinerary.title: Tranquil Sands
activities: Visit the quiet Kashid Beach (famous for its white sand) or Murud Beach.
Explore the Padmadurg Fort from a distance.

itinerary.title: Return
activities: A relaxed drive back to Mumbai or take the M2M Ferries (Ro-Ro) from Mandwa to save driving time.

itinerary.title: The Journey South
activities: A full day's drive (approx. 10-11 hours) from Mumbai to Malvan.

itinerary.title: Under the Sea
activities: Head to the massive Sindhudurg Fort.
Spend the day Scuba Diving or Snorkeling in the clear waters surrounding the fort.
Evening at Chivla Beach.

itinerary.title: River Meets Sea
activities: Visit Devbagh for a boat safari to see the Sangam, Tsunami Island, and dolphin spotting.

itinerary.title: Architectural Marvels
activities: Visit the Kunkeshwar Temple (a stunning temple on the edge of the sea) and the quiet Mithbav Beach.

itinerary.title: Return
activities: Early morning departure for the return journey to Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Alibaug
activities: Leave early (5:00 AM) for Alibaug.
Spend the day at Nagaon Beach (famous for water sports) and visit the Kolaba Fort during low tide.
Return to Pune by night.
